library_preparation_preflight.summary: graphql-dgs-spring-graphql is almost entirely Spring Boot auto-configuration/interceptor glue code; its published Gradle module metadata exposes graphql-dgs, spring-graphql, spring-web and spring-boot-autoconfigure only on the runtime variant, not the api variant, so the bare resolved-artifact scaffold cannot compile any test that uses @DgsComponent/@DgsQuery or references DgsQueryExecutor/Spring GraphQL types. Upstream's own build.gradle.kts for this exact module (tag v10.5.0) confirms it: it declares spring-webmvc, spring-webflux and spring-test as compileOnly in main, and its own tests add spring-boot-starter-graphql, spring-boot-starter-test, spring-boot-starter-web and spring-webflux explicitly.

deterministic_setup.reason: Core DGS annotations (@DgsComponent, @DgsQuery, @DgsData) and the DgsQueryExecutor/DgsReactiveQueryExecutor interfaces this module implements live here; graphql-dgs-spring-graphql only lists it on its runtime variant, not api, so it is invisible to test compile classpath otherwise.

The library's public surface is Spring Boot auto-configuration (DgsSpringGraphQLAutoConfiguration, environment post-processors); exercising it meaningfully needs Spring's test context support (e.g. ApplicationContextRunner), which isn't pulled in by the bare artifact. spring-webmvc is compileOnly upstream, so DgsWebMvcGraphQLInterceptor and the MVC auto-configuration branch are unreachable without adding it explicitly.

spring-webflux is compileOnly upstream, so DgsWebFluxGraphQLInterceptor and SpringGraphQLDgsReactiveQueryExecutor's reactive path are unreachable without adding it. Version matches the spring-web 6.2.10 this artifact already resolves transitively (same Spring Framework release train as Boot 3.5.5).

library_preparation_preflight.agent_guidance: This module's two web-stack branches (servlet vs reactive) are mutually exclusive inside one ApplicationContext (@ConditionalOnWebApplication(type=SERVLET) vs type=REACTIVE), so write two separate test contexts/classes if you want to reach both DgsWebMvcGraphQLInterceptor and DgsWebFluxGraphQLInterceptor rather than one context that imports both starters. DGS's DgsConfigurationProperties defaults schema discovery to classpath*:schema/**/*.graphqls, so a minimal .graphqls schema must exist under src/test/resources/schema/ or DgsSpringGraphQLAutoConfiguration's graphQlSource bean will fail to build. No Docker image or external service is involved; this is a pure in-process Spring/GraphQL integration.
risks: Pinned peer versions (spring-boot 3.5.5 / spring-framework 6.2.10) were chosen to match what this artifact already resolves transitively; Gradle's conflict resolution should keep them aligned, but recheck if generateMetadata pulls a different spring-boot-autoconfigure version.

Upstream's own test build also adds caffeine and an internal graphql-dgs-spring-graphql-starter-test module; these cover the optional APQ-caching path and aren't required for baseline reachability, so they were intentionally left out.
Local Gradle/checkMetadataFiles/native-image verification remains authoritative — this is a literature/metadata-based inference, not a confirmed compile.
